_about: Dungeons journal quests no rule in tools/lib/codex/journal.js can place (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Dungeons): a quest whose giver, ender and area lie outside its instance and whose objective no rule ties to it: an item made inside, or found inside on a mob or object the data has not placed there; or one picked up or handed in inside at someone the data has not placed. One row per quest and instance: { quest, instance (Codex instance key), inside (optional: ["start"], ["finish"] or both, where it is picked up or handed in inside the instance), source (a URL, a web quest database citation, or a source cited the way forever-db/corrections cite one: { kind, ref }, players' recordings for one), note }. A row with exclude: true (and no inside) takes off the page a quest a rule put there wrongly. Loaded by loadJournalQuests; a row whose quest or instance the Codex lacks is a build warning.

quests.note: Rot and Regret: Forever's quest text sends the player into Maraudon for a Vial of Earth Song Water, then back to Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens in Desolace. The outdoor giver and ender do not identify the dungeon; this association keeps the quest listed when its objective data has no instance link (checked 2026-11-15, #2430).

Shards of the Felvine (Rabine Saturna, Moonglade): Forever's quest data says Type: Dungeon, and its objective is to find the Felvine in Dire Maul, take a shard from it once Alzzin the Wildshaper falls and seal it in the Reliquary of Purity (checked 2026-10-15). QuestieDB files it under Moonglade and lists only the Sealed Reliquary of Purity, which no NPC drops.

Haze of Evil (Alliance; Gregan Brewspewer, Feralas, for Muigin in Un'Goro): five Atal'ai Haze, which only the Murk Worms, Saturated Oozes and Deep Lurkers drop, and the Forever world database spawns those only inside the Sunken Temple (map 109). Forever's quest data and CMaNGOS's classic-db call it a dungeon quest; our NPC data has no spawns for the three, so no rule placed it (checked 2026-11-09).

Zapper Fuel (Horde; Liv Rizzlefix, Ratchet, for Larion in Un'Goro): five Atal'ai Haze from the Murk Worms, Saturated Oozes and Deep Lurkers, which the Forever world database spawns only inside the Sunken Temple (map 109); CMaNGOS's classic-db files the quest under the Sunken Temple's zone. Our NPC data has no spawns for the three, so no rule placed it (checked 2026-11-09).
